info.title: Satnam Registrar API
info.description: Public interface of the Satnam sovereign Nostr identity registrar. Endpoints marked with x-satnam-status 'gated' are implemented and tested but disabled by default until the operator enables them; they respond 501 live_requires_authorization. Do not treat a gated endpoint as live. Satnam never returns key material.

tags.name: agent-birth
tags.description: Bot-Mother births agent identities into the mirrored role structure.

get.description: Unauthenticated by design. Returns version and registrar public identity summary. No secrets.

post.description: Creates an agent identity inside the caller's group, with lineage and a delegated-authority mirror receipt. Requires NIP-98 authentication signed over the request method, URL and body. Replayed or unsigned requests are rejected. The response never contains secret material; it returns a reference only. Gated: returns 501 live_requires_authorization until the operator enables it.

label.description: Agent label. Sanitized to [a-z0-9_-] with a bounded length.

200.description: Identity birthed. Dry mode returns the same shape with dry-labelled values and writes nothing.

400.description: Malformed request, invalid label, or invalid JSON body.

401.description: Missing, invalid, or replayed NIP-98 authentication.

403.description: Delegation or authority refused, or dry execution disabled in production.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded. Returns a retry delay.

501.description: live_requires_authorization. The endpoint is implemented but gated off.

get.description: Verifies the encrypted PICC data and SUN CMAC from a physical tag, enforcing counter monotonicity and replay rejection. Public by design (the SUN payload is the proof). Rate limited per card. Gated: behind the issuer flag, default-off.

409.description: Replay rejected: counter not ahead of the last seen value.

nip98.name: Authorization
nip98.description: NIP-98: a signed Nostr event (kind 27235) covering the request method, URL and body hash, presented as 'Nostr <base64>'. Satnam verifies the signature, the payload hash and a bounded timestamp window, and rejects replays.

x-satnam-policies.autonomy: No autonomous customer-facing decisions; consequential actions require human approval.
x-satnam-policies.flagging: Suspicious patterns are flagged for human review rather than permanently blocked.
x-satnam-policies.discovery: Open to agentic discovery by design.
